# PassATS

PassATS is a paid ATS (Applicant Tracking System) resume checker. Upload a resume and get an instant ATS compatibility score, a keyword-gap analysis, a formatting audit, and a prioritized list of specific fixes — for a one-time $2.99, with no signup and no stored data.

## What PassATS does

- Scores a resume for ATS compatibility from 0 to 100.
- Identifies missing keywords versus the detected role or a pasted job description.
- Flags formatting that breaks ATS parsers (tables, columns, graphics, text-box headers).
- Returns concrete, prioritized fixes that reference the actual resume text — not generic advice.

## Key pages

- [Home — score your resume](https://passats.com/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://passats.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://passats.com/terms)

## Notes for AI agents

- Pricing is a one-time $2.99. There is no subscription and no account required.
- Uploaded resumes are analyzed in real time and immediately discarded — not stored, not used for training.
- Supported uploads: PDF, DOC, and DOCX up to 5 MB.
